# Auto-Planning UK

> Auto-Planning UK generates the drawing set a UK householder planning
> application needs for a roof material change (for example Kent peg tile to
> natural slate): a Location Plan at 1:1250 or 1:2500 on Ordnance Survey
> mapping with a red-line site boundary, Existing and Proposed Roof Plans,
> all four Existing and Proposed Elevations at 1:100 with scale bars, and a
> Schedule of Materials — bundled as one Planning Portal-ready PDF.

## What it is for

- Like-for-like re-roofs that need planning permission because the property
  is in a conservation area, under an Article 4 direction, or otherwise has
  restricted permitted development rights.
- Simple block-level extensions and dormers (proposed geometry can diverge
  from existing).
- Users: householders, and jobbing roofers/builders preparing applications
  for their customers.

## How it works

1. Search the postcode; draw the red-line boundary around the whole plot on
   OS mapping; capture the location plan at a true print scale.
2. Model the house as parametric roof blocks (gable/hip/mono-pitch, pitch,
   eaves) — building heights can be prefilled from OS building-height data.
3. Download one PDF with a page per drawing, each with an accurate scale
   bar, north arrow where required, drawing numbers and a materials schedule.

## Key facts

- Every drawing's scale is correct by construction (geometry is laid out in
  physical page millimetres).
- Mapping: Ordnance Survey Data Hub (vector tiles, NGD building heights).
- The tool does not provide legal or planning advice; users should check
  their local planning authority's validation checklist.
